endpoints.summary: Freeze one SKU's video request into a drafting job. The draft carries the backend's estimate (amount, currency, price source) or null when unknown. Creating a draft is free; nothing is generated or charged until an approval with a cost cap.
One generation with its plan, plan_hash, estimate and status.
Approve the reviewed plan_hash with a cost cap; starts paid generation.

response.summary: Video generation (INT-535 §5): freeze one SKU's video request (prompt ≤ 7000 chars, optional brief { style, product, soundscape, music, setting, lighting { key, direction: top_left | top | top_right | left | right | front | back | overhead, fill, rim } } and per-segment beats — each with an optional shot { size: extreme_close_up | close_up | medium_close_up | medium | medium_wide | wide, angle: eye_level | low | high | overhead } — compiled into the official H3 three-field prompt in LTX order (style, setting, lighting, preserve, shots; a pronoun-led shot that does not name the product gets it inserted); duration 4–35 s (default 15) split into 4–15 s segments; 768P/2K; aspect_ratio one of 21:9 | 16:9 | 4:3 | 1:1 | 3:4 | 9:16, default 9:16; keyframe budget) into a drafting job; idempotent per idempotency_key. 400 when beats do not sum to the segment, a beat is shorter than 1 s, the plan's last beat is not a still hold (camera static, action holding), brief.product.preserve is empty, a compiled prompt exceeds 7000 chars, or a prompt carries a <d> dialogue tag (no speech). Nothing is generated until approved.

body.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: A quiet home-goods commercial in the manner of a Scandinavian interiors catalogue: photoreal product photography, a palette of pale bamboo, warm white and soft grey; quiet tone; contemporary; one continuous unbroken take with a locked-off camera. The scene is a matte white bathroom wall. Lighting: soft daylight from the top-left, with a gentle white fill from the front. The Casa Verde bamboo wall hook keeps its bamboo material, its shape and its details exactly as in Picture 1; only lighting, background and framing change. Picture 1 shows the Casa Verde bamboo wall hook, set of two. No one speaks; there is no dialogue or voice-over.

Shot 1: Medium shot, eye level. The Casa Verde bamboo wall hook sits mounted on the white wall, its pale grain catching the daylight. The camera stays static.

At 3.00 seconds: Shot 2: Close-up, low angle. Keeping the same framing, the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the Casa Verde bamboo wall hook.

At 6.00 seconds: Shot 3: Medium shot, eye level. The Casa Verde bamboo wall hook, fully in frame, its front facing the camera, and everything holds still. The camera stays static.

overall_soundscape: A quiet bathroom room tone.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
